title: 직장 · 업무
intro: 설문에서 '학생'을 선택하면 학교·캠퍼스 묘사 → 학교에서의 하루 일과 → 기억에 남는 팀 프로젝트나 시험 경험 → 고등학교와 대학교 생활 비교 순서로 출제됩니다. 페르소나는 서울에 있는 대학교 3학년 경영학과 학생으로, 지하철로 30분 걸려 통학하고 같은 과 친구 Minji와 대부분의 수업을 함께 듣습니다. 자기소개의 'I'm a college student majoring in business.'를 그대로 확장하면 되므로 가장 준비하기 쉬운 주제입니다.
strategy: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장(Okay, let me tell you about my school.) → 기본 정보(학교·전공·학년) → 세부(캠퍼스·수업·하루) → 느낌·이유 → 마무리 문장(Yeah, that's my school life.)
캠퍼스 묘사는 '정문 → 큰 잔디밭(main lawn) → 경영대 건물 → 도서관 → 학생 식당' 순서로 걸어가듯 말하면 막히지 않습니다.
일과는 '지하철 30분 → 9시 수업 → Minji와 학생 식당 점심 → 오후 수업 → 도서관이나 카페에서 과제' 시간 흐름을 따르세요.
경험은 '마케팅 수업 팀 프로젝트 발표', 비교는 '고등학교(정해진 시간표·교복) vs 대학교(내가 짜는 시간표·자유와 책임)' 하나씩만 준비하면 충분합니다.

expressions.en: Okay, let me tell you about my school.
I'm a junior in college, majoring in business.
It takes about 30 minutes by subway to get to school.
My weekdays are pretty busy because I have a lot of classes.
The campus is really big, and there are a lot of trees.
I usually have lunch with my friend Minji at the cafeteria.
expressions.ko: 보통 친구 Minji랑 학생 식당에서 점심을 먹어요.

expressions.en: My first class starts at nine.
After class, I study at the library.
This semester, I'm taking five classes.
expressions.ko: 이번 학기에 다섯 과목을 듣고 있어요.

expressions.en: We had to give a presentation in front of the whole class.
expressions.ko: 반 전체 앞에서 발표를 해야 했어요.

expressions.en: In high school, I had to follow a fixed schedule.
expressions.ko: 고등학교 때는 정해진 시간표를 따라야 했어요.

expressions.en: Now I can choose my own classes.
expressions.ko: 지금은 수업을 직접 고를 수 있어요.

expressions.en: I have more freedom, but I also have more responsibility.
expressions.ko: 자유는 더 많지만 책임도 더 커요.
expressions.note: more A, but also more B 로 대조

expressions.en: It was a lot of pressure, but it really paid off in the end.
expressions.ko: 부담이 컸지만 결국 정말 보람이 있었어요.

expressions.en: So yeah, that's pretty much what my school life is like.
expressions.ko: 그러니까 네, 제 학교생활은 대충 그래요.
expressions.note: 마무리 문장: what ~ is like = ~가 어떤지

questions.en: You indicated in the survey that you are a student. Tell me about your school. What does the campus look like, and what do you study there?
questions.ko: 설문에서 학생이라고 하셨네요. 다니는 학교에 대해 말해 주세요. 캠퍼스는 어떻게 생겼고, 거기서 무엇을 공부하나요?
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 학교·학년·전공 → 캠퍼스 묘사(잔디밭·경영대 건물·도서관·식당) → 좋아하는 장소와 이유 → 마무리
big, old, modern, green 같은 쉬운 형용사로 장소를 하나씩 소개하세요
'My favorite place on campus is ~.' 한 문장으로 개인적인 느낌을 넣으세요

answers.IM3: Okay, let me tell you about my school. I'm a junior at a university in Seoul. I'm majoring in business. It takes about 30 minutes by subway to get there. The campus is really big, and there are a lot of trees. In the middle, there is a big lawn. The business building is new and modern. There is also a large library and a cafeteria. My favorite place is the library. Yeah, that's my school.
answers.IH: Okay, let me tell you about my school. I'm a junior at a university in Seoul, and I'm majoring in business. It takes about 30 minutes by subway from my home, and the campus is just a few minutes from the station. The campus is really big, and it's full of trees, so it's beautiful in spring and fall. When you walk in through the main gate, you see a huge lawn where students sit and chat. On the right, there's the business building. It's pretty new and modern, with big classrooms and a nice study lounge. There's also a large library and a student cafeteria. My favorite place on campus is the library, because it's quiet and I can focus there. I take most of my classes with my friend Minji. So yeah, that's my school.
answers.AL: Okay, let me tell you about my school. I'm a junior at a university in Seoul, majoring in business. It's about 30 minutes from my home by subway, and the campus is only a few minutes' walk from the station, which is really convenient. The campus is huge, and it's full of trees and old stone buildings, so it looks amazing in spring when the cherry blossoms come out. When you walk in through the main gate, the first thing you see is a big lawn right in the middle. On sunny days, it's packed with students having lunch or just lying in the sun. The business building is on the right. It was built just a few years ago, so it's super modern, with big lecture halls, comfortable study rooms, and even a small cafe on the first floor. Next to it is the main library, which is honestly my favorite place on campus. It has huge windows and long desks, and it's so quiet that I can really focus. My best friend Minji is in the same major, so we take most of our classes together. So yeah, that's pretty much what my school is like.

questions.en: Tell me about a typical day at school. What do you usually do from the time you arrive on campus until you go home?
questions.ko: 학교에서의 평범한 하루를 말해 주세요. 캠퍼스에 도착해서 집에 갈 때까지 보통 무엇을 하나요?
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 등교(지하철 30분, 이어폰으로 음악) → 오전 수업 → Minji와 점심 → 오후 수업 → 도서관·카페에서 과제 → 귀가 → 마무리
First / After that / Then / In the evening 으로 시간 순서를 잡으세요
'My weekdays are pretty busy because ~.' 로 바쁜 이유를 한 번 넣으세요

answers.IM3: Okay, let me tell you about my school day. My weekdays are pretty busy because I have a lot of classes. I take the subway to school, and it takes about 30 minutes. My first class starts at nine. After my morning classes, I have lunch with my friend Minji at the cafeteria. Then I have one or two more classes. After class, I study at the library. I get home around six. Yeah, that's my typical school day.
answers.IH: Okay, let me tell you about a typical school day. My weekdays are pretty busy because I'm taking five classes this semester. I usually leave home around eight and take the subway to school. It takes about 30 minutes, so I listen to music with my earphones on the way. My first class starts at nine, and it's usually a big lecture, like marketing or accounting. After my morning classes, I meet my friend Minji, and we have lunch at the student cafeteria. The food is cheap and pretty good. In the afternoon, I have one or two more classes. After that, I usually go to the library or a cafe to do my assignments. Sometimes I have team meetings for group projects too. I usually get home around six or seven and have dinner with my family. So yeah, that's my typical day.
answers.AL: Okay, let me walk you through a typical school day. My weekdays are pretty packed, because I'm taking five classes this semester, and most of them are business classes like marketing, accounting, and finance. I usually leave home around eight and hop on the subway. It's about a 30-minute ride, so I put on my earphones and listen to some IU songs to wake myself up. My first class starts at nine, and honestly, it's always a struggle to stay focused that early. After my morning classes, I meet my friend Minji, and we grab lunch at the student cafeteria. It's cheap, and the food is actually not bad, so it's kind of our daily routine. We usually spend lunch complaining about assignments, which is weirdly fun. In the afternoon, I have one or two more classes. After that, I either head to the library or the cafe near my place to work on assignments. A lot of my classes have team projects, so some days I also have meetings with my group, which can drag on for hours. By the time I get home, it's usually around six or seven, and I have dinner with my family. So yeah, that's pretty much what my school day looks like.

questions.en: Tell me about a memorable experience you had at school, such as a team project or an exam. What happened, and why do you remember it so well?
questions.ko: 팀 프로젝트나 시험처럼 학교에서 있었던 기억에 남는 경험을 말해 주세요. 무슨 일이 있었고, 왜 그렇게 기억에 남나요?
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 언제·어떤 수업(작년 마케팅 수업) → 무슨 프로젝트(카페 마케팅 계획) → 어려웠던 점 → 발표와 결과 → 느낌 → 마무리
과거시제를 유지하세요: had to, worked, stayed up, gave, got
'I was so nervous, but ~' 처럼 감정 변화를 넣으면 IH 이상으로 올라가요

answers.IM3: Oh, let me think. Last year, I had a big team project in my marketing class. There were four people in my team, and Minji was one of them. We had to make a marketing plan for a small cafe. We met every week and worked really hard. The night before the presentation, we stayed up very late. I was so nervous, but the presentation went well. We got an A! Yeah, that was a great experience.
answers.IH: Oh, let me think. The most memorable experience was a team project in my marketing class last year. There were four people in my group, including my friend Minji. We had to make a marketing plan for a small local cafe, so we actually visited a cafe near my home and talked to the owner. We met every week for about two months. It wasn't easy, because one of our team members didn't really help much. So Minji and I had to do a lot of extra work. The night before the presentation, we stayed up until three in the morning to finish our slides. I was so nervous when I gave the presentation in front of the whole class. But it went really well, and we got an A. So yeah, that's a project I'll never forget.
answers.AL: Oh, that's a good question. Let me think. The one that really stands out is a team project from my marketing class last year. There were four of us in the group, including my friend Minji, and we had to come up with a full marketing plan for a small local business. We chose the little cafe near my apartment, since I'm a regular there, and the owner was nice enough to let us interview her. At first, everything went smoothly. But halfway through the semester, one of our teammates kind of disappeared. He stopped coming to meetings and didn't answer our messages. So Minji and I ended up doing a lot of his part. It was really stressful, and to be honest, we were pretty upset with him. The night before the presentation, we were at a 24-hour cafe until three in the morning, fixing our slides and practicing over and over. When it was my turn to present, my hands were literally shaking. But once I got started, I relaxed, and the professor actually said our plan was the most realistic one in the class. We got an A, and the cafe owner even used one of our ideas. It was a lot of pressure, but it really paid off in the end. So yeah, that's pretty much why I'll never forget that project.

questions.en: How is your school life now different from when you were in high school? Compare the two and tell me which one you prefer.
questions.ko: 지금의 학교생활은 고등학교 때와 어떻게 다른가요? 둘을 비교하고 어느 쪽이 더 좋은지 말해 주세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 고등학교(정해진 시간표·교복·야간 자습) → 대학교(직접 짜는 시간표·팀 프로젝트·자유) → 어느 쪽이 좋은지와 이유 → 마무리
In high school, I had to ~ / Now I can ~ 패턴으로 차이를 2~3개만 말하세요
'more freedom, but more responsibility' 같은 대조 문장 하나로 깊이를 더하세요

answers.IM3: Sure, I'd love to talk about it. My school life is very different now. In high school, I had to wear a uniform. I had classes from eight to four, and then I studied at school until late at night. Now I'm in college, and I can choose my own classes. I can wear whatever I want. But I have a lot of team projects. I like college life better because I have more freedom. Yeah, that's the difference.
answers.IH: Sure, I'd love to talk about it. My school life now is really different from high school. In high school, I had to follow a fixed schedule. I went to school at eight, wore a uniform, and stayed in the same classroom with the same classmates all day. After class, I studied at school until ten at night to prepare for the college entrance exam. Now that I'm in college, I can choose my own classes and make my own schedule. Some days I don't have class until the afternoon, so I can sleep in a little. I can also wear whatever I want. But I have more team projects and presentations, so it's busy in a different way. I prefer college life, because I have more freedom, even though I also have more responsibility. So yeah, that's how my school life has changed.
answers.AL: Sure, I'd love to talk about it, because the two are completely different. In high school, pretty much everything was decided for me. I had to be at school by eight, wear a uniform, and sit in the same classroom with the same classmates all day. After regular classes ended, we had self-study time at school until ten at night, all to prepare for the college entrance exam. It was exhausting, and honestly, there wasn't much room for anything else. Now that I'm a junior in college, it's a totally different story. I can choose my own classes and build my own schedule, so some days I don't start until the afternoon and can sleep in a bit. I can wear whatever I want, and I get to meet people from all kinds of majors. But college comes with its own challenges. There are way more team projects and presentations, and nobody tells you what to do. If you fall behind, it's on you. So I'd say I have more freedom, but also a lot more responsibility. Even so, I definitely prefer college life, because I feel like I'm finally making my own choices. So yeah, that's pretty much how my school life has changed.

pronunciation.tip: 첫 음절 '캠'에 강세, a는 입을 옆으로 벌린 '애'. 두 번째 음절은 약하게 '퍼스'
'메이져'처럼 첫 음절에 강세, 끝 r은 혀를 말아서. '메이저'처럼 끊지 않기
영어로는 2음절 '비즈-니스'. 가운데 i는 소리 나지 않으니 '비지니스'처럼 늘려 말하지 않기
